page_title: LEE 0-1 MCI | Leeds v Manchester City 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Referee Peter Bankes has finally had enough of Daniel Farke and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and it's Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+2' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Savinho (Manchester City) for a tough tackle.
90+2' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

88' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
88' Corner kick. Anton Stach (Leeds) is ready to send the ball into the box.
88' Substitution. Nathan Ake (Manchester City) in, Rayan Cherki out.
87' Daniel Farke prepares a substitution. Joe Rodon is replaced by Jaka Bijol (Leeds).
87' The game has come to an end for James Justin. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Joel Piroe (Leeds).
86' Daniel James (Leeds) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Leeds manage to earn a corner.
85' Anton Stach (Leeds) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
85' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) receives a yellow card!
82' The linesman signals that Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
78' Peter Bankes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by James Justin (Leeds) and blew his whistle.
78' A lofted cross from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
76' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel James (Leeds) replacing Jayden Bogle.
75' Substitution. Ilia Gruev did his best and is replaced by Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
74' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
73' Marc Guehi (Manchester City) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
72' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the corner.

72' What a great touch by Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.
70' Nico O'Reilly is substituted due to injury. Pep Guardiola gives a chance to Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City).
68' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Omar Marmoush will be replaced by Savinho (Manchester City).
68' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) unleashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box which goes a few yards wide of the right post.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) coming on for Brenden Aaronson.
63' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
62' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
61' Rough tackle by Ilia Gruev (Leeds). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Peter Bankes no option but to blow his whistle.
54' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) is adjudged offside.

51' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
51' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
50' Anton Stach (Leeds) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

49' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Leeds have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Rayan Ait-Nouri feeds Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:1.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' Flag up against Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
42' The free kick is delivered by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
41' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Manchester City have a free kick.
41' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

41' Well-positioned Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the top of the net, but Karl Darlow reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.

39' He should have scored! Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Gianluigi Donnarumma makes an easy save.
38' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
36' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
35' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

34' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
33' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
30' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
27' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
27' Leeds have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

25' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
24' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Leeds win a free kick.
22' The corner is swung in but Leeds can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

22' Anton Stach (Leeds) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Leeds will have a corner.
21' Chance! Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Jayden Bogle, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.

18' James Justin (Leeds) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
17' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
13' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
12' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) is caught offside!
7' The Leeds players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Leeds will kick-off.
Stuart Attwell will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
